# Introduction

This is one other __catalytic__ vignettes go into the particularities of example of Cox Regression from paper `Bayesian Inference on Cox Regression Models Using Catalytic Prior Distributions`.

# Demo

```{r obs data prepare}
devtools::load_all()
predict_log_PL_compute <- function(real_beta,
                                   pred_beta,
                                   X_test,
                                   Y_test,
                                   status_test) {
  term1 <- get_cox_pl(X_test,
                       Y_test,
                       status_test,
                       real_beta)
  term2 <- get_cox_pl(X_test,
                       Y_test,
                       status_test,
                       pred_beta)

  return(term1 - term2)
}

M <- 1000 # Synthetic data size
n <- 100 # Observation data size
test_n <- 100 # Test data size

p <- 20 # Number of covariance
sim_times <- 3 # Simulation times
taus <- seq(0.1, 10, 0.1) # Taus for CV

iter <- 2000 # iteration for stan
warmup <- 1000 # warnup for stan
chains <- 1 # chains for stan


rho <- 0.5
censor_rate <- 0.1

all_result_squareloss_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = sim_times, nc = 2)
all_result_log_pl_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = sim_times, nc = 2)
all_tau <- matrix(0, nrow = sim_times, nc = 2)

for (sim in 1:sim_times) {
  cat("\n simt_imes:", sim)
  # Generate obs data
  X_obs <- matrix(rnorm(n * p), n, p)
  X_test <- matrix(rnorm(test_n * p), test_n, p)
  # X_obs<-scale(X_obs)
  X_obs[, 1] <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.9)
  X_test[, 1] <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.9)

  X_obs[, 3] <- rchisq(n, 1)
  X_test[, 3] <- rchisq(n, 1)

  X_obs[, 2] <- rchisq(n, 4)
  X_test[, 2] <- rchisq(n, 4)

  X <- X_obs
  beta <- c(4, -4, 3, -3, 1, -1, 1, -1, rep(1, p - 8)) / sqrt(p)

  Xbeta <- as.numeric(X %*% beta)
  X_testbeta <- as.numeric(X_test %*% beta)

  TT <- sapply(1:n, function(i) {
    rexp(1, 0.5 * exp(Xbeta[i]))
  })

  TT_test <- sapply(1:n, function(i) {
    rexp(1, 0.5 * exp(X_testbeta[i]))
  })


  if (censor_rate == 0.1) {
    pre_value <- quantile(TT, 0.95)
    pre_value_test <- quantile(TT_test, 0.95)

    C <- runif(n, 0, pre_value)
    C_test <- runif(test_n, 0, pre_value_test)

    censor_rates <- sum(C < TT) / n
    censor_rates_test <- sum(C_test < TT_test) / n
    target_censor_rate <- censor_rate
    target_censor_rate_test <- censor_rate
    while (abs(target_censor_rate - censor_rates) > 0.02) {
      C <- runif(n, 0, pre_value)
      censor_rates <- sum(C < TT) / n
      # print(censor_rates)
    }

    while (abs(target_censor_rate_test - censor_rates) > 0.02) {
      C_test <- runif(test_n, 0, pre_value_test)
      censor_rates <- sum(C_test < TT_test) / test_n
      # print(censor_rates)
    }
  }
  if (censor_rate == 0.2) {
    pre_value <- quantile(TT, 0.90)

    C <- runif(n, 0, pre_value)
    censor_rates <- sum(C < TT) / n
    target_censor_rate <- censor_rate
    while (abs(target_censor_rate - censor_rates) > 0.02) {
      C <- runif(n, 0, pre_value)
      censor_rates <- sum(C < TT) / n
      # print(censor_rates)
    }
  }
  if (censor_rate == 0.4) {
    pre_value <- quantile(TT, 0.70)

    C <- runif(n, 0, pre_value)
    censor_rates <- sum(C < TT) / n
    target_censor_rate <- censor_rate
    while (abs(target_censor_rate - censor_rates) > 0.02) {
      C <- runif(n, 0, pre_value)
      censor_rates <- sum(C < TT) / n
      # print(censor_rates)
    }
  }

  Y_status <- t(sapply(1:n, function(aa) {
    c(min(C[aa], TT[aa]), (C[aa] > TT[aa]))
  }))

  Y_status_test <- t(sapply(1:n, function(aa) {
    c(min(C_test[aa], TT_test[aa]), (C_test[aa] > TT_test[aa]))
  }))

  Y <- Y_status[, 1]
  Y_test <- Y_status_test[, 1]
  status <- Y_status[, 2]
  status_test <- Y_status_test[, 2]


  obs_data <- as.data.frame(cbind(X, Y_status))
  colnames(obs_data) <- 1:ncol(obs_data)

  data_ <- data_initialization_cox(formula = survival::Surv(`21`, `22`) ~ 1, data = obs_data, syn_size = 1000)
  
  cat("\n cat_cox_bayes")
  
  cox_bayes <- cat_cox_bayes(formula = ~.,
                          data_ = data_,
                          taus = taus,
                          chains = chains,
                          iter = iter,
                          warmup = warmup)
  
  cat("\n weihao_cat_cox_bayes")
  my_syndata <- list(
    T.syn = data_$syn_time,
    X.syn = data_$syn_x,
    status.syn = data_$syn_event,
    h_star = sum(data_$syn_event) / mean(data_$syn_time) / nrow(data_$syn_x)
  )
  
  cv_result_list <- weihao_five_fold_cv_tau(taus, taus, X, Y, status, my_syndata)
  
  best_tau_penalty_cv <- cv_result_list$best_tau_penalty
  
  wh_cat_cox_bayes <- weihao_Bayesian_cox_cat_stan(X, Y, status, data_$syn_x, as.vector(data_$syn_time), as.vector(data_$syn_event), tau = best_tau_penalty_cv)
  
  weihao_cox_bayes_taup_beta <- rstan::summary(wh_cat_cox_bayes)$summary[
    grep("beta", rownames(rstan::summary(wh_cat_cox_bayes)$summary)),
    "mean"]
  
  
  all_tau[sim, ] <- c(
    cox_bayes$tau,
    best_tau_penalty_cv
  )


  all_result_squareloss_matrix[sim, ] <- c(
    norm(beta - cox_bayes$coefficients, "2")^2,
    norm(beta - weihao_cox_bayes_taup_beta, "2")^2)

  all_result_log_pl_matrix[sim, ] <- c(
    predict_log_PL_compute(
      beta,
      cox_bayes$coefficients,
      X_test,
      Y_test,
      status_test
    ),
    predict_log_PL_compute(
      beta,
      weihao_cox_bayes_taup_beta,
      X_test,
      Y_test,
      status_test
    ))
}
  
  # cat("\ncox_cre")
  # cox_cre <- cat_cox(
  #   formula = ~.,
  #                            data_ = data_,
  #                            method = "CRE",
  #                            tau = p
  # )
  # cat("\ncox_wme")
  # cox_wme <- cat_cox(
  #   formula = ~.,
  #                            data_ = data_,
  #                            method = "WME",
  #                            tau = p
  # )

  # CV
```
